svg.font-family: system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: P — Sketchbook · Thrills & Chills round-5 art concept
svg.text: A designer’s sketchbook page: pen ink that overshoots the
corners, marker washes laid off-register, blue-pencil
construction lines, hatched shadows, hand-lettered notes.

g.text: Ink: 1.5 px pen, every edge overshoots 1-4 px.
Shade = a second marker pass on the same face.
Shadows: pen hatching. Guides: blue pencil.
Riders sit in chair-tubs and coaster cars.
